subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.-----SOC.RT.
description: Diagram closing MP(I)-53 — the section on rock music's appeal to the controlling political forces of western culture as a *sanctioned* form. The prose immediately above identifies the structural mechanism: 'the utilization of rock music was found to be attractive because the meta-reality of the form was not in disagreement with the vibrational arena of the controlling community — in short, the forces controlling events in the west utilize rock to the extent they do because there is no separation between what that form is and who they are — and the controlling forces dictating policy in the American functional establishment are not revolutionary... Rock music was found to be an attractive commodity because of its ability to fall within the sanctioned reality of American culture — that is: the idea of rock having anything to do with revolution was an idea probably thought up at Columbia Records.' The crossing diagrams the structural fit between rock-information-dynamics and the sanctioned social-reality: INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's actual information working) crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the sanctioned receiving cultural reality). INFO-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; its main line runs down-right to SOC-RT, the partner-axis. RT-DY (reality dynamics) rises from the main line to the upper-right, with DEC (decentralization) branching from RT-DY's line and INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) on the right margin, reached through a further branch off RT-DY's line that ends in an unlabeled dot. BIA (bi-aitional) drops from the main line, with TR (transformation) branching from BIA's line and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) from TR's line. CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) drops from the main line toward bottom-center, with LANG (language) and (P)RE-DEF (redefinitions as a point of idea completion) branching from CRTF-PROG's line.
